title: Control Ownership Matrix and Evidence Handshake Plan for SOC2/ISO Milestones
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate a minimal-latency evidence handshake between product, engineering, and security so that SOC2/ISO control evidence is collected, verified, and stamped for audits with clear ownership and automatic handoffs. This ticket produces the control ownership matrix, a timeboxed evidence-staging window model, an automated 'handoff' checklist, and a rollback/fallback policy for missed evidence paths.
milestones: Design control-ownership matrix and publish to Confluence (owner mapping and escalation flow) - target 2026-02-26
Experiment: 2-week evidence staging window for SSO/SAML + Auditlog retention - pilot on staging - target 2026-03-15
Implement lightweight webhook verification for evidence receipts (security sign-off flow) - PR #8472 - target 2026-04-05
Run cross-functional dry-run with Legal/Support/Infra, capture gaps - target 2026-04-20
Finalize automation and schedule first enterprise cutover for customers on 2026-05-10
acceptance_criteria: All controls mapped to an owner and secondary owner in Confluence with SLA for evidence collection
Staging window documented with freeze/rollback SOP and integrated into release calendar
Webhook evidence receipts recorded in audit dashboard and surfaced in Console
One successful dry-run with no unresolved high/critical findings
Handbook page and runbook published for SRE/Support with playbook for missed evidence
risks: Owners not responsive in short staging window resulting in missed evidence (mitigation: escalation cadence and auto-reminders)
False positives from automated webhook receipts (mitigation: verification signature + periodic manual audits)
Integration lag with private deployments where KMS/HSM evidence differs (mitigation: separate sub-flow and extended window)
Customer-facing cutover may require rollback if audit telemetry degraded (mitigation: canary and feature-flag rollback)
stakeholders: Product: Aisha Patel (owner), Marcus Liu (PM partner)
